$comment: Copy deck for gen-art.mjs. Edit this file, never the script. Every entry is rendered twice, once per theme, into profile/assets/gen/<name>-light.svg and -dark.svg. Text is live SVG text rendered with the visitor's system fonts, so keep display lines short: the layouts carry about 25% slack and nothing is boxed tight around a string.
